answer: Each agent must lock a non-refundable stake bond on a public atlas of execution lineages before its task bids are accepted. Independent verifier nodes sample cross-cluster routes like water filtering through porous karst bedrock, tracing shared funding sources and timing correlations across every bridge between accounts. An attacker spinning up N fake identities must post N separate bonds that cannot be pooled, and any detected cluster collusion slashes the entire bonded stake across all linked personas.
